title: Total Qty sort puts untracked parts below tracked parts both ways
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have five parts, part A, part B, part C, part D and part E, each with one bin location that holds a quantity above 0 (no bin below zero), so the sort and the Total Qty cells agree.
  • Set parts A, B and C as tracked parts, with 5, 5 and 2 on hand.
  • Set parts D and E as untracked parts, with 1 and 9 on their shelf.
  • Give parts A, B, C, D and E descriptions that start with the same text and end, in turn, with ALPHA, BRAVO, CHARLIE, XRAY and YANKEE.
  • Give parts A, B, C, D and E part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists all five.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the Total Qty column header.
  3. Click the Total Qty column header again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A, B, C, D and E are listed.

Step 2:

  • The Total Qty header shows a sort arrow.
  • Low to high, the rows read part C (2), part A (5), part B (5), part D, part E; high to low they read part A (5), part B (5), part C (2), part D, part E. One of these two orders shows.
  • Parts A and B have the same quantity, so part A (ALPHA) comes before part B (BRAVO).
  • The untracked parts D and E sit below every tracked part, part D (XRAY) before part E (YANKEE), even though part E has 9 on its shelf.

Step 3:

  • The arrow turns round and the other of the two orders shows.
  • Parts D and E are still at the bottom, part D before part E, in this direction too.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State)

  • S6-R3: “The Total Qty column can be sorted.”
  • S6-R4: “When that column is sorted, untracked parts sit below every tracked part, in both sort directions.”
  • S6-R5: “Tracked parts sort against each other by quantity.”
  • S6-R6: “Tracked parts with the same quantity are then ordered by description, A to Z.”
  • S6-R7: “Untracked parts are ordered by description, A to Z.”

From: Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026, written against PRD v22; re-shared by the QA lead on 27 Oct 2026, unchanged), read 27 Oct 2026

  • §6 Phase 5, Key code changes: “Known pre-existing gap, not fixed here: the SQL sorts on p.quantity, while the cell shows the bin-derived available quantity.”
